# k-ecos Skill Lifecycle

- **Skill**: k-ecos
- **Status**: active

## Description

Queries the Bank of Korea Economic Statistics System (`한국은행 경제통계시스템 ECOS`) Open API for Korean macro-financial statistics — base rate, exchange rates, money supply, interest rates, GDP, and the `100대 통계지표` (100 key indicators) quick lookup. Covers statistics-table discovery, item-code lookup, time-series data retrieval, terminology glossary, and metadata lookup. Requires ECOS_API_KEY environment variable; a public demo key (`sample`) works for smoke tests capped at 10 rows per request.
